title: FlickerTalk plugin manifest
description: What module.json says about a plugin. The app reads it only after the catalogue's signature checks out (Plan §49–§50).

id.description: Reverse domain name, lowercase; the folder the plugin is served from.

minCoreVersion.description: The oldest FlickerTalk this plugin runs on (§51).

components.description: The web components it registers; the first one is what the app shows.

summary.description: One line about what it does, for the catalogue. In English.

permissions.description: What it asks the user for. Installing grants none of it (§53).

network.description: Hosts it may reach, never wildcards or URLs. The core checks every call against this (§55).

messages.description: Whether it may read the message or text the user hands it. It never reads more.

send.description: How far it goes when it writes in the chat: not at all, it fills the composer, or it sends.

print.description: Whether it may ask the phone to print what it made. The user picks the printer.
